text: A woman with long, flowing red hair and orange eyes reclines, wearing a white draped garment tied at the waist with blue rope. She has fair skin, a curvaceous build, and wears a blue choker and bracelets. Her right hand hovers above a glowing blue orb she’s conjuring. The setting appears dimly lit, possibly a chamber with shelves in the background. Her pose is relaxed yet focused on the magical act.
